name: Cua Lo beach
kicker: The sand of this city, along Bình Minh
summary: Swim and walk the sand at Cửa Lò when the day is the beach. The national page calls the shore long, the water clear enough to see the sand, and the salinity moderate. Casuarina lines đường Bình Minh. Keep every distance: 16 km, 17 km, 18 km, and about 20 km. A chair fee was not printed. Check on arrival.
getThere: 16 km, 17 km, 18 km, or about 20 km. About 30 minutes is only the Núi Cấm road.
heroCaption: The sand at Cửa Lò, with the tree line, coracles, and an island offshore. The pages do not agree which island this is.

notice.title: This square is not the one in town
notice.body: Quảng trường Bình Minh is on this sand. Quảng trường Hồ Chí Minh is at Hồ Tùng Mậu and Trường Thi. They are not the same square.

gettingThere: Four distances stay. The national beach page prints 18 km from Vinh and about 30 minutes by car on the Núi Cấm road, and puts the sand along đường Bình Minh. The city portal prints 17 km. A 2012 national tourism news page prints 16 km to the east, and describes the beach then as longer than 12 km. The national beach page says longer than 10 km. Both lengths stay. A 3 May 2025 news page prints about 20 km. The other three distances do not print minutes. Check on arrival.

Older pages still say thị xã Cửa Lò. From 1 December 2024 the former town is inside Vinh. From 1 July 2025 the beach wards are phường Cửa Lò. Two city bus lines are named toward the beach: Bến Thủy–Trường Thi–Cửa Hội–Cửa Lò, and Bến Thủy–Quang Trung–Quán Bánh–Cửa Lò. Fares are check on arrival. A 2012 page names đảo Ngư, đảo Mắt, and đảo Lan Châu off this shore. The 2025 page names Song Ngư and a cable car longer than 3.5 km, and calls chùa Song Ngư more than 800 years old, about 4 km on from Cửa Lò at Cửa Hội. The provincial tour names đảo Hòn Ngư and chùa Song Ngư. Do not merge those islands into one. A crossing time and a fare were not printed.

legs.heading: From the square
legs.body: By car or the city bus lines named above. Use all four distances: 18 km and about 30 minutes on the Núi Cấm road, 17 km, 16 km east, and about 20 km. Do not collapse them. A chair on the sand was not given a price. Check on arrival.

closed: A closing hour for the sand was not printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: The sand’s own fee was not printed. Check on arrival. For the 2025 season the city made showers, public toilets, parking, and wifi free. That sentence is the season, not a standing bylaw. A chair is check on arrival.
